fichas.title: Underfloor heating: screed and floor-temperature requirements
fichas.summary: Heating pipes laid directly on thermal insulation require a specified minimum cement-screed cover. Differential expansion under ceramic flooring may require upper reinforcement; carpet or parquet does not require reinforcement according to the text. DIN 4725 gives maximum floor-surface temperatures, and the text notes that underfloor heating is normally feasible within the stated heating-demand condition.

fichas.title: Heating oil storage: siting and protection requirements
fichas.summary: Heating oil storage guidance covers storage duration, a maximum quantity in the heating room, containment for leaks, and protection measures for underground tanks. Indoor tanks may be plastic battery tanks or steel tanks welded on site; the storage room must be accessible, checked for leaks, and capable of containing the oil in case of leakage. Filling, venting, and overfill-protection equipment are required, while leak-warning systems may depend on storage type.
